title: [Free Assets] Complete 16x16 Pixel Art Ecosystem (10 Modular Packs, AI-Assisted Pipeline, Unified 58-Color Palette)
author: steemitgoldminer
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’ve been working on a massive workflow experiment: building a fully modular, interlinked 16x16 top-down asset ecosystem entirely designed for indie game prototypes and jams using AI-assisted sprite pipelines.

The biggest pain point I kept running into with AI-generated pixel art was consistency—color clashes, broken grids, and mismatched perspectives across different packs. So, I spent a lot of time structuring a fixed pipeline to lock down a **unified 58-color palette**, consistent grid metrics, and uniform tile/monster bounds.

I’ve just published all **10 completed packs** for free on Itch.io. Here is what is in the ecosystem:

* **Modular World & Town Tiles:** Terrain, interiors, props, and building structures built to exact 16x16 grid increments.
* **Animated Monsters & Characters:** 40+ sprite sheets with uniform pivot bounds so you don't have to rebuild colliders from scratch.
* **UI Elements:** Combat and inventory components matching the same palette.
* **Cross-Interlinked:** Every pack links to the others so you can seamlessly mix-and-match sets without color bleeding or style mismatch.

Everything is 100% free (Name Your Own Price) for any personal or commercial project:

[https://michelclauwaertgmailcom.itch.io/](https://michelclauwaertgmailcom.itch.io/)

If you're working on a quick prototype or a jam game in Godot, Unity, or GameMaker, feel free to grab them. Let me know if you run into any formatting issues with the sprite sheets!
